faqs.question: Does Social0 work with AI agents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Connect via the MCP server at mcp.social0.app/mcp (ChatGPT, Claude, OpenClaw, and other MCP clients), use the REST API at api.social0.app/v1, or the official CLI (npm install -g social0). Agents draft, schedule, and publish through the same pipeline as the dashboard.

faqs.question: How do I connect ChatGPT or Claude via MCP?
faqs.answer: Add Social0 as a remote MCP server (mcp.social0.app/mcp) with an API key from Dashboard → Developer. Once connected, ask your agent to draft, schedule, or publish — posts show up in Social0 like any other.

faqs.question: Does Social0 have an API and CLI?
faqs.answer: Yes. REST API at api.social0.app/v1 (works great from Postman), MCP at mcp.social0.app/mcp, and npm install -g social0 for the CLI. Create API keys in Dashboard → Developer.

faqs.question: What platforms does Social0 support?
faqs.answer: Nine platforms today: Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, and Pinterest — for instant publish and scheduling. See the Platforms section on this page for the full list. Want another network? Email support@social0.app.

faqs.question: Is there a free plan?
faqs.answer: Yes. Free includes 3 connected accounts and 10 posts. No credit card required.

faqs.question: How many social accounts can I connect?
faqs.answer: Free connects 3, Creator 15, and Agency 59, then $1/month per extra account with no cap. Each connected profile counts once. See Pricing for the full breakdown.

faqs.question: What types of content can I post?
faqs.answer: Text, images, videos, carousels (multi-image), and platform-native formats where supported — so you can share the same content types you already post manually.

faqs.question: Can I manage multiple brands or workspaces?
faqs.answer: Yes on every paid plan. Create workspaces for separate brands or clients, connect accounts per workspace, and switch between them from the dashboard.

faqs.question: Will my posts get less reach using Social0?
faqs.answer: No. Posts go out through each platform's official APIs — the same channels legitimate schedulers use — so reach matches posting from the native app. Algorithms change, but we don't throttle or shadow your content.

faqs.question: What happens if a platform fails to publish?
faqs.answer: If one platform fails (for example due to an API error or rate limit), the other platforms will still publish normally. You'll see exactly which platforms succeeded and which failed.

faqs.question: Can I cancel anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. No contracts and no cancellation fees. Cancel anytime from Billing; you keep access until the end of the current billing period.
